it.profile_email_delivery_550_description: SMTP 550 means the recipient server rejected the message. Gmail reports that the sender is not authenticated: SPF and DKIM did not pass.

fi.profile_email_delivery_generic_descripti: SMTP-palvelin palautti virheen, kun SiteBrush lähetti viestiä.

de.profile_email_delivery_spf_dkim_fix: Add the SPF TXT record below for the sender domain. If an SPF record already exists, edit that record and include this server IP; do not create a second SPF record.
de.profile_email_delivery_dns_intro: Add this TXT record at the DNS provider for the sender domain. If an SPF record already exists, add this server IP to the existing v=spf1 record instead of creating a second SPF record.
